scenarios.description: Authored contents of every container base form over base game + DLC + packs (fnv.sim.containers/1) against the independent oracle tools/capture/oracle_sim.py.

Value, weight, health and biped flags of every inventory item record over base game + DLC + packs (fnv.sim.items/1, docs/spec-notes/simulation.md section 7) against the independent oracle tools/capture/oracle_sim.py items; checks the item layouts of the Layer 1 schema (incl. IMOD, CHIP, CCRD, CMNY) end to end.

Pick up stimpaks and caps in Doc Mitchell's house, add/remove items, leave through the front door; item counts and the player's cell/position after each step (parity-lab/inputs/layer4/goodsprings_doc_mitchell.actions.json) against an in-game capture (docs/spec-notes/simulation.md section 6). Position tolerance 1 game unit: the XTEL destination is copied, but the engine may settle the actor.

Leveled-list outcomes (chance none, each-item-in-count, all levels vs highest eligible level, use all, uniform pick) of seven FalloutNV.esm lists: fnvtool sim sample histograms (parity-lab/inputs/layer4/leveled_basic.cases.json) against in-game samples (docs/spec-notes/simulation.md section 6, 'Leveled-list samples'). Chi-square test per case, alpha 0.01.

Leveled-list outcomes (backlog B8: LVLG globals set from the console, all-levels lists with the player level between or equal to entry levels, a count without each-item-in-count, nesting 3 to 5 deep with chance none and a count carried into an each-item sublist) of ten lists from FalloutNV.esm and DeadMoney.esm: fnvtool sim sample histograms (parity-lab/inputs/layer4/leveled_b8.cases.json) against in-game samples (docs/spec-notes/simulation.md section 6, 'Leveled-list samples'). Chi-square test per case, alpha 0.01.

Encumbrance, equipping and the calendar on a test save in Doc Mitchell's house (parity-lab/inputs/layer4/goodsprings_weight_and_time.actions.json): carried weight and capacity (in-game GetAV InventoryWeight / CarryWeight) at Strength 5 and 1, before and after equipping armour that shares a body slot, and GameDay/GameMonth after waiting 24 + 6 hours and across a month end, against an in-game capture (docs/spec-notes/simulation.md section 6). Fractional time (GameHour, GameDaysPassed) is not observed: in-game the clock keeps running while the player is in menus and could not be stopped without crashing the game (docs/spec-notes/xnvse-capture.md section 5). Absolute tolerance 0.01 (f32 weights summed).

Enable-parent propagation in X-13 (OldWorldBlues.esm cell NVDLC03X13): GetDisabled of children, grandchildren and opposite-state children after disabling and re-enabling their root parents, incl. an initially-disabled child of an opposite link (parity-lab/inputs/layer4/x13_enable_parents.actions.json), against an in-game capture on a test save (docs/spec-notes/simulation.md section 6).

Merchant container restock, independent of the save's hidden restock time: Ringo's cash box 0x001629C0 (merchant container of ACHR 0x00104C7D) in GSGasStation is emptied, read 72 h later (player stays inside, no menus), emptied again and read 84 h later (parity-lab/inputs/layer4/goodsprings_merchant_restock.actions.json), against an in-game capture. Both reads expect a restock under either model the captures allow (restock on access after 72 h since the last restock, or on a 72 h schedule); docs/spec-notes/simulation.md section 3.

Merchant restock days: Ringo's cash box 0x001629C0 in GSGasStation (player stays inside, no menus; parity-lab/inputs/layer4/goodsprings_merchant_midnight_restock.actions.json) is emptied and read 72 h later, left full 96 h, emptied at start+7 days and read 24 h later, then emptied at start+8 days with a stimpak put in and read daily for 3 days, against an in-game capture (save nvftest, GameDaysPassed 12.388). Restocks come at midnights whose GameDaysPassed is 0 or 3 modulo 7 (docs/spec-notes/simulation.md section 3), not at a fixed time after the last restock or an access: the box stays empty over start+8 (day 20 in game, 13 in the simulation) and refills over start+9 (21 / 14), stimpak gone. The hidden last-restock time of the save plays no part, but the reads depend on where the start falls in the 7-day cycle: they are the same for any start between 5 and 6 modulo 7, which holds for both the authored clock (5.0) and the save (12.388).

A locked container opened with its key (parity-lab/inputs/layer4/goodsprings_locked_safe_key.actions.json): the wall safe 0x00105229 in GSHouseInterior02 (level 50, key VZKeyDirtyGSHome2SafeKey), emptied and given 2 stimpaks, activated by script without the key, with it, emptied into the player, locked again and activated without and with the key. Observes GetLocked (`locked`), whether each activation opened the container menu (`opened`, MenuMode 1008) and item counts, against an in-game capture (save nvftest, coc GSHouseInterior02; docs/spec-notes/simulation.md section 5).

A lock without a key (parity-lab/inputs/layer4/goodsprings_locked_safe_no_key.actions.json): the floor safe 0x0010B2D4 in GSGasStation (level 25, no key), emptied and given 7 caps, activated by script while locked, after Unlock (then emptied into the player), after Lock and after Lock 255. Observes GetLocked (`locked`), whether each activation opened the container menu (`opened`, MenuMode 1008) and cap counts, against an in-game capture (save nvftest, player inside the gas station; docs/spec-notes/simulation.md section 5).

Dropping items and taking them back (parity-lab/inputs/layer4/goodsprings_drop_and_retake.actions.json): with 3 stimpaks, the player leaves Doc Mitchell's house by the front door, drops 1, takes the dropped reference back by scripted Activate, drops 2 and takes that reference back. The dropped reference is named created:Stimpak (the newest reference a drop made from that base that is still in the world; in game found by scanning the player's cell, docs/spec-notes/simulation.md section 7). Observes the player's stimpak counts and the dropped references' cell and position, against an in-game capture (save nvfdoc). Position tolerance 1 game unit, as for goodsprings_doc_mitchell.

Cell respawn of an ordinary container (parity-lab/inputs/layer4/goodsprings_cell_respawn.actions.json): the General Store fridge 0x00105824 (base VLootFridgeClosedTier1WastelandRS, Respawns flag, leveled contents, no merchant) and the toolbox 0x001057FF (no Respawns flag) are emptied and given one teddy bear each, an item their leveled lists cannot yield, so the observation is exact: the teddy bear is gone exactly when the container was reset. Absences from GSGeneralStore (leaving and coming back by the console's coc, time by GameHour) of 48, 1 (after 30 h inside), 40 + 40, 71 and 73 hours, after a first 74 h absence that resets the cell whatever the save remembers. Against an in-game capture (save nvftest; docs/spec-notes/simulation.md section 3, iHoursToRespawnCell 72). Only `count` is compared; the golden's other fields (stacks, clock, Chet's merchant box) are diagnostics.

A placed explosive activated by script (parity-lab/inputs/layer4/nipton_placed_mines.actions.json): the frag mine 0x0013A656 (PGRE, base MineFragProjectile) in NiptonHouse8Paranoid, `<mine>.Activate player`: Frag Mines held before and after, the mine's GetDisabled and position before and after, and whether a menu opened, against an in-game capture (save nvftest, coc into the house; docs/spec-notes/simulation.md section 1). Position tolerance 1 game unit.
